faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our Event Management System.

q1.question: What is EMS and how does it work?
q1.answer: EMS (Event Management System) is a comprehensive platform for managing events of all sizes. It handles everything from registration and accreditation to check-in, analytics, and post-event reporting. Simply create your event, customize your settings, and let EMS handle the rest.

q2.question: How secure is the platform?
q2.answer: Security is our top priority. We use enterprise-grade encryption, secure QR/NFC technology for check-ins, and comply with international data protection standards including GDPR. All data is stored in secure, redundant data centers.

q3.question: Can EMS handle large-scale events?
q3.answer: Absolutely! EMS is built for scale. We've successfully managed events with over 50,000 attendees and can handle high-throughput check-ins with our real-time scanning technology. Our infrastructure automatically scales to meet demand.

q4.question: What integrations are available?
q4.answer: EMS integrates with popular tools including CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal), email platforms (Mailchimp, SendGrid), and many more. We also offer a robust API for custom integrations.

q5.question: Do you offer custom branding options?
q5.answer: Yes! Our white-label solutions allow you to fully customize the platform with your branding, including logos, colors, and custom domains. Your attendees will experience a seamless branded journey.

q6.question: What support options are available?
q6.answer: We offer 24/7 customer support via email, phone, and live chat. Enterprise clients receive dedicated account managers and priority support. We also provide comprehensive documentation and training resources.
